tag.description: Tiny uppercase corner tag, e.g. MISTAKE, GRAMMAR

label.description: Turkish pill above the hook, e.g. 'Türkler bunu hep yanlış söylüyor'

hook.description: 1-second English hook question, e.g. 'Can you spot the mistake?'

wrong.description: The wrong sentence. Wrap ONLY the wrong word(s) in ~~double tildes~~.

turkish_hint.description: Why a Turkish speaker says it: 'Türkçe düşününce: ...'

correct.description: The correct sentence. Wrap the corrected word(s) in ==double equals==.

why.description: One-line explanation in Turkish. Use **bold** for the key term.

cta.description: Save/share call to action, Turkish, 1 emoji max
